note: jit-exits: correctness gate for pair monojit1108c (docs/537 §20: VtOps B1, CallExit A5b, NewVt B5, game list C2/C2b) as one bundle (Rodney 2026-11-08: compiler gains are not measured per piece). No timing. Order: (1) bp-jit-exits-smoke (all on, stops the queue on FAIL); (2) bp/ip/sv-jit-exits-capture (15 min each, Mode=1 Capture=1, all switches on); (3) host replay between the jobs, queue.ts has no host step: node tools/jit-replay.ts --capture probe-out/jit-capture-<w>-cint.jitcap --out probe-out/jit-capture-<w>-cint.txt --summary, then with MONOHOST_JITINLINE=2 MONOHOST_JITWIDE=1 MONOHOST_JITVTOPS=1 MONOHOST_JITCALLEXIT=1 MONOHOST_JITNEWVT=1: node tools/jit-replay.ts --run probe-out/jit-capture-<w>-cint.txt --mode verify --lazy; gate 0 differ, 0 faulted, MISMATCH 0 (one rerun on the known host rebuild flake), else stop before (4); (4) bundle on vs off per world (bp/ip/sv-jit-exits-bundle-on/off, Mode=2 verify, jit set as jit-batch.json). Pass per bundle job: no crash, 0 'jit verify MISMATCH' (logForbid), scriptErrorsMax 0, >= 1 'jit: compiled' and the OK line reading back VtOps, CallExit and NewVt (logRequire), jitLazyCalls >= 1000, jitMismatch 0, jitFaults 0 (nativeRequire). C0 count arms (bp/ip/sv-jit-exits-count, pair monojit-count1108, ts3native 0.36.206): bundle on + [MonoJit] Count=1, a measurement run only (an inc per compiled position and exit, so never a timing arm); pass = the bundle-on gates + OK line with Count=1 + >= 1 jitcount: end line; read with node tools/jit-hot.ts --game-count <job ts3native.log> --out <host-style.log>, then jit-hot.ts --count / jit-exit-census.ts --census on that file. Run after the merge: --only bp-jit-exits-count,ip-jit-exits-count,sv-jit-exits-count --no-smoke. Run: node tools/harness/queue.ts tools/harness/queues/jit-exits.json --no-smoke --only bp-jit-exits-smoke,bp-jit-exits-capture,ip-jit-exits-capture,sv-jit-exits-capture; replay (3); then --from bp-jit-exits-bundle-on --no-smoke. C3 game port (pair monojitc3g1108, ts3native 0.36.209, 2026-11-08): the *-jit-c3g-* jobs repeat the same order with FastCopy and Ldsflda added to the bundle (all five on vs all five off; OK line reads FastCopy and Ldsflda back). Run: node tools/harness/queue.ts tools/harness/queues/jit-exits.json --no-smoke --only bp-jit-c3g-smoke,bp-jit-c3g-capture,ip-jit-c3g-capture,sv-jit-c3g-capture; host replay of probe-out/jit-capture-<w>-c3g.jitcap as (3) with MONOHOST_JITFASTCOPY=1 MONOHOST_JITLDSFLDA=1 added; then --only bp-jit-c3g-bundle-on,bp-jit-c3g-bundle-off,ip-jit-c3g-bundle-on,ip-jit-c3g-bundle-off,sv-jit-c3g-bundle-on,sv-jit-c3g-bundle-off --no-smoke.
